The Cebu City Sports Commission (CCSC) organized the three-day tournament, which kicked off on Friday, November 20. CCSC Chairman Dr. Rhoel Dejano and Executive Director Rocky Alcoseba led the organizers, with the approval of Cebu City Mayor Nestor Archival.
